turns.prompt:
Calculate downtime from monitor/collector-*.csv for the UTC window [2026-10-18T10:00:00Z, 2026-10-18T11:00:00Z). For each device, combine all files and process rows by time, not physical row order. Times are distinct within each device. Every device starts UP before its earliest recorded event. DOWN changes it to down until the next UP; repeated DOWN while down and repeated UP while up do nothing. Count only the seconds of down intervals overlapping the window. Events before the window establish its starting state; an outage still open at 11:00 is counted only up to 11:00. Include every device appearing in the logs, even if its downtime is zero. Write summary.csv with header device,downtime_seconds, integer seconds and ASCII device order; no total row.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.

provenance.author: codex:gpt-6.1-sol
provenance.notes: Sort cross-collector transitions, ignore repeated states, clip outages to an hour and close ongoing outages at the window end.
